title: What a Corrected Number Leaves Out
thesis: Accurate corrected agreement supports an explanatory comparison only to the extent that the available joint evidence, assessed through the actual protocol, gives the observed result a likelihood advantage.
contribution: A worked diagnostic distinguishing fixed and fitted corrections, preservation of associations, distributed evidential responsibilities and the causal boundary of controller records.
strongest_objection: The diagnostic may be an application of established sufficiency and enriched-evidence principles with limited additional philosophical significance.
originality_limitations: No historical priority or general minimum archive established; closest Boyd, Tal and Jalloh literature was only partially available in the original source stage.
open_questions: How much of this diagnostic is already developed in the closest full texts?
What access and provenance guarantees make distributed evidence practically adequate?
How does the diagnostic perform with uncertain nuisance parameters and real control systems?
